limitations: Observed cases only, not full XML/name/native parity. XML replay differences are retained as observed.
System-library identities are captured receipts; only packaged prefix libraries and fonts physically rehashed.
Native warnings/failures preserved verbatim, including timestamps/PIDs/pointers if present.
No native external-link prohibition instrumented; product resolver counters are separate evidence.

qualification.outcome: All four direct/native XML replay outputs, normalized warning messages and imported name records match compiled SDK/Shell.
qualification.warningComparison: Portable diagnostic payloads match native warning messages. Native timestamps/PIDs/wrapper punctuation are preserved raw and not claimed byte-identical.
qualification.scope: Explicitly global undefined names, declaration/placeholder order, name-failure ordering and shared ordinary-cell recovery only.
